high_level_description: This image is a four-panel comic strip from the Instagram account "comics.collective." The comic is titled "Chances are low but neve..." with the rest of the title cut off. Panel 1: A person with short brown hair is kneeling beside another person who appears to be injured. The injured person has a red mark on their chest, resembling a bullet wound. The kneeling person asks, "MY GOD, HAVE YOU BEEN SHOT?" Panel 2: The injured person is now standing and holding onto a large, blue, mythical creature that resembles a unicorn with a pink horn
